result_preview.description: This data product synthesizes Contract, PurchaseOrder, and Vendor information to provide comprehensive spend visibility and vendor performance insights. It summarizes procurement metrics including contract utilization, order frequency, and vendor reliability trends to enable data-driven sourcing decisions and supplier relationship optimization.

result_preview.title: Procurement Spend Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregated spend metrics and vendor performance trends across purchase orders and contracts.
result_preview.description: A derived analytical data product that consolidates procurement spend data across vendors, purchase orders, and active contracts. It provides pre-calculated KPIs including category spend distribution, vendor spend concentration, contract utilization rates, and period-over-period spend variance. This product enables procurement teams to identify optimization opportunities, monitor vendor performance, and support strategic sourcing decisions.

result_preview.description: Delivers real-time analytical views of procurement operations, including vendor scorecards, purchase order aging, invoice reconciliation status, and material cost trends. Enables procurement teams to optimize supplier relationships, reduce cycle times, and identify cost-saving opportunities across the supply chain.
